# Approval Policy Checklist: Role-Based Approval Limits

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirement language for the invoice approval policy, including thresholds, sequence rules, rejection behavior, and auditability.
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the /speckit-checklist command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item [x] only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: [x] means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the approval thresholds for Manager and Director explicitly documented, including the inclusive boundary behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the large-invoice escalation requirements fully specified for amounts above 500,000, including the first- and second-approver sequence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the rejection and no-mutation requirements defined for every invalid approval attempt scenario? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, §FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the approval policy assumptions and boundary conditions documented for unsupported or multi-role user scenarios? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 - Is the phrase "up to" translated into a measurable rule that clearly covers 50,000 and 500,000 as valid approval amounts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the distinction between a single-role approval and a two-step approval clearly defined for each invoice amount range? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec state the required reason and outcome for rejected actions in a way that can be objectively reviewed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, §SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 - Are the approval rules consistent across the user stories, functional requirements, and the edge-case section without contradictory interpretations? [Consistency, Spec §User Scenarios, §Requirements, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 - Do the rule definitions align with the approval-history and auditability expectations described in the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are the assumed currency and role-handling rules consistent with the business description and the clarifications section? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-012, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 - Are the success criteria measurable enough to judge whether valid approvals are accepted and invalid ones are rejected without ambiguity? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the user scenario outcomes written as observable business outcomes rather than implementation-oriented details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1, §User Story 2, §User Story 3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 - Are the primary, alternate, and exception approval flows fully represented for standard, boundary, and large-invoice scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the duplicate-approver and non-director second-approver conditions treated as explicit required scenarios rather than implied behavior? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 - Are the threshold-boundary cases, duplicate reviewer cases, and invalid second-approval attempts clearly documented as required outcomes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the behavior for unsupported roles or multiple-role users explicitly addressed, or is the exclusion clearly documented as a pending business decision? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 - Are the auditability, traceability, and clear-reason requirements sufficiently defined for review and operational trust? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the requirement for no partial mutation on rejected attempts sufficiently specific to support validation and regression prevention? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-008, §SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 - Are the assumptions about the base accounting currency and the in-memory workflow explicitly scoped so they do not overreach into unsupported features? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are external dependencies or policy exceptions identified as assumptions rather than hidden requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK021 - Are there any remaining ambiguous terms or unstated decisions in the approval policy that would materially affect implementation or user expectations? [Ambiguity, Spec §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK022 - If a conflict or open issue exists, is it isolated to a specific business decision and not left as an implicit implementation choice? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items [x] only after reviewer assessment confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when clarification, correction, or additional specification detail is still needed.
- This checklist validates requirement quality, not implementation correctness.
- The built-in requirements checklist under checklists/requirements.md is managed separately by the spec workflow.
